rows.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
rows.claim: Saʿd reports that a Bedouin asks for devotional words; the Prophet teaches monotheism, magnification, praise and the verse's glorification formula, then asks forgiveness, mercy, guidance and provision.
rows.anchor: مصعب بن سعد بن أبي وقاص، عن أبيه

rows.speaker: أبو حاتم
rows.claim: Abu Hatim says requests for guidance mean asking to remain steadfast and increase in guidance, since a believer has already been guided.
rows.anchor: قال أبو حاتم رضي الله عنه: كل ما في هذه الأخبار: اللهم اهدني

words: فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ
rows.speaker: عروة بن الزبير
rows.claim: Urwa reports that Abu Hudhayfa adopted Salim; after 33:5, adopted children were returned to known fathers, or treated as brothers in faith and clients when fathers were unknown.
rows.anchor: أخبرني عروة بن الزبير أن أبا حذيفة بن عتبة بن ربيعة وكان من أصحاب رسول الله

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: When Sahla asked what to do now that adult Salim could no longer be treated as her natural son, the Prophet told her to nurse him five times, establishing milk kinship.
rows.anchor: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "أرضعيه خمس رضعات

rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: Aisha applied the adult-nursing instruction to men she wanted to admit to her presence, having her sister and nieces nurse them.
rows.anchor: فأخذت بذلك عائشة فيمن كانت تحب أن يدخل عليها من الرجال

rows.speaker: سائر أزواج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet's other wives held that adult nursing was a dispensation for Salim alone and refused to admit anyone on that basis.
rows.anchor: وأبى سائر أزواج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يدخل عليهن بتلك الرضاعة

rows.speaker: عبد الله بن بسر
rows.claim: Ibn Busr reports that when a Bedouin asked for a practice to hold fast to, the Prophet advised keeping one's tongue continually moist with remembrance of God.
rows.anchor: عن عبد الله بن بسر، قال: جاء

rows.speaker: معاذ بن جبل
rows.claim: Muadh reports that, when he asked which deeds God loves most, the Prophet answered that one should die with a tongue moist from remembrance of God.
rows.anchor: عن معاذ بن جبل، قال: سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: ابن عمر
rows.claim: Ibn Umar reports that at the conquest of Mecca the Prophet said God had removed pre-Islamic tribal pride, and that people are either pious and honored or wicked and low; he recited this verse.
rows.anchor: عن بن عمر قال: طاف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم على راحلته القصواء يوم الفتح

rows.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud says one should report only what one knows and that admitting ignorance is itself knowledge; he cites the Prophet's refusal to be among the pretentious.
rows.anchor: فأتيت ابن مسعود، قال: وكان متكئا، فغضب، فجلس، وقال: يا أيها الناس من علم شيئا

rows.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud identifies the smoke verses with Quraysh's famine after the Prophet prayed for seven lean years: they saw smoke, Abu Sufyan sought relief, the punishment lifted, and they returned to disbelief.
rows.anchor: فأتيت ابن مسعود، قال: وكان متكئا، فغضب، فجلس، وقال: يا أيها الناس من علم شيئا

rows.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud identifies the great seizure and the promised binding punishment with Badr, and says the Roman episode and four events had passed.
rows.anchor: فأتيت ابن مسعود، قال: وكان متكئا، فغضب، فجلس، وقال: يا أيها الناس من علم شيئا

words: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ
